title: Hardcore Locked
description: Want a REAL challenge? Hardcore locked is here for you! Even easy mode is REALLY hard. Hardcore mode is ridiculous. Anyone capable of beating the Wither, Ender Dragon, and Elder Guardian is a true master of the game!
body:
![HARDCORE LOCKED](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d27f04fe81bf7af6911795ddddc78e17ffacac9f.png) Want a REAL challenge? Hardcore locked is here for you Even easy mode is REALLY hard. Hardcore mode is ridiculous. Anyone capable of beating the Wither, Ender Dragon, and Elder Guardian is a true master of the game! This pack adds more common enemy spawns with harder enemies, and intensifies the game and the risk of death at all times. Don't get too cold or too hot, and definitely stay hydrated. If you don't, you will always be vulnerable. # Features Added * **More Mob Spawns** - mobs like charged creepers, husks, cave spiders, and more will spawn everywhere, bringing up the intensity * **Smarter Mobs** - mobs like spiders have improved abilities, like crawling and leaving behind messes of webs * **Harder Boss Fights** - bosses like the wither, ender dragon, and elder guardian have higher health and damage, and new attacks * **Intense Mechanics** - make sure you always stay cool and warm and hydrated, and make sure you don't sleep in the open, or else... * **Improved Reward?** - more animals will drop slightly better stuff, but overall the rewards are the same, to push a challenge * **Meaner Animals** - some mobs, like the squid, will be a lot more difficult to deal with since they attack * **Greater Accomplishment** - beating this on hardcore mode is guaranteed to be more of an accomplishment than the normal game # It Doesn't Stop There! The game is pre-optimized with a lot of quality mods to make sure it runs well while you experience the hardness. Plus, new updates are underway to improve the optimization and challenge overall! No need to install your favorite optimization mods, they're already here! Part of the Bryant Quest series, use Bryant Quest Visuals to enhance the visual aspect of the game!

FAQ

**Q:** **Does this modpack add extensive new enemies or environments to the game?**
**A:** No, this modpack is focused on providing a experience that looks vanilla but plays like it's much harder and different.** --- **Q:** **How do you beat the game in this modpack?**
**A:** Although the ender dragon fight is harder, beating the game should be straightforward with normal Minecraft. --- **Q:** **Where can I report bugs or errors in the code?**
**A:** You can report bugs on GitHub [Here](https://github.com/Herjiberb/Bryant/discussions). --- **Q:** **Does it support multiplayer at all?**
**A:** As long as you both have the same mods installed, multiplayer should be smooth. Credits to all of the hard working creators that created the mods in this pack! # Credits and Mods used
